title: Recovering Spatial Tensor Systems by Intersection
exact_target: Determine when constructing a free product system from a spatial tensor system and then intersecting tensor products recovers that original system.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001180 (OWR-3392-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Product Systems and Independence in Quantum Dynamics (2009), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2009/09, pp. 493--548; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF page 38, printed page 530.
free product systems; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: Generation by the starting system is a theorem of the construction in this report. Recovering the starting tensor system by intersection, and characterizing free systems admitting that description, are the unresolved questions. This reverses a construction, whereas ID 30001178 asks generation inside a given free system.
